name: Antonina Levedeva
source:
"Clearly, you have no manners OR decency whatsoever..! Rather than behaving like an uncivilized animal, you should at least ATTEMPT to conduct yourself with dignity while in such a formal setting!"

Having grown up with wealth and privilege, Antonina is an overcritical stuck-up brat who is used to getting exactly what she wants, exactly when she wants it. Though she may at times seem more enthusiastic, she's prone to fits of anger when things don't suit her
taste.

Her fascination with princesses and fairytales has led her to set extremely high standards for others, so she will quickly grow impatient with anyone she deems "inferior" or finds to be lacking as far as manners are concerned. She is insulting and judgmental, and doesn't forgive easily when others make mistakes.

Snobby and conceited, she tends to focus more on trivial matters than the situation at hand, but she is by no means unaware or oblivious.
